901792.desc: Pilates is for strengthening, core, and flexibility on a Reformer. Learn how to maneuver the Pilates Reformer machines in this 30 minute demo. After completing this demo, you can sign up for regular Pilates Reformer classes. These are paid classes.

997286.name: Les Mills Yoga Hatha
997286.desc: This class focuses on alignment, strength and stability. Move with precision through slower sequences that build body awareness and keep you present.

1134090.name: CANCELED: Family Yoga
1134090.desc: Yoga is an ancient practice designed to integrate the body, mind and spirit. Bring the whole family, ages 6 and up, to learn basic yoga poses together while improving balance, increasing flexibility and reducing stress.

707843.name: Basic Step
707843.desc: This class offers basic but cardio-intensive step choreography for a great workout!

949634.name: Lower Body Strength
949634.desc: This class uses a variety of weights, barbells, tubes, bands and other equipment to train and strengthen your legs, glutes, abs, and lower back.

767151.name: H2O Dance
767151.desc: Enjoy various styles of dance exercise in the water while moving to the best music grooves around. A great water workout!

706686.name: HIIT
706686.desc: Get out of your comfort zone and accelerate results with high-intensity interval training. Classes combine short bursts of intense exercise with short recovery periods, and utilize cardio and strength exercises. Formats include Tabata, AMRAP and more.

708211.name: Zumba Toning
708211.desc: This innovative strength training program employs Latin-inspired Zumba dance moves and music with 2.5 pound toning sticks to help you build muscular endurance while enjoying a fun dance workout.

708353.name: Cardio Drumming
708353.desc: Cardio drumming combines cardio exercise and drumming to the rhythm of the music for a fun, fast-paced way to get your heart rate up, improve your coordination, build total body strength, and burn calories. You don't need to be a drummer to do it, and even more amazingly, you don't even need drums! All fitness levels are welcome.

708388.name: CANCELED: Youth Cardio Blast
708388.desc: The circuit-style class helps youth foster positive attitudes and build team work skills. Foundational strength and cardio exercises along with dynamic stretching work the whole body. Class is geared towards ages 5-14, but all youth are welcome. **If the class is taking place in Yplay or the YAC, then it will only available to those ages.

707903.name: Swim Lessons - Pool Closed
707903.desc: The pool will be closed for swim lessons.

709677.name: YMCA Programming - 3 Lanes
709677.desc: YMCA programming is taking place in 3 lanes in the pool.

896159.name: Swim Lessons - Therapy Pool Closed
896159.desc: The pool will be closed for swim lessons.

1101733.name: Swim Lessons - Pool Closed to Open Swim/Family Swim

1010939.name: LES MILLS Strength Development
1010939.desc: Whether new to lifting or a seasoned pro, LES MILLS Strength Development will build muscle, improve technique, and grow your confidence so that you can train more powerfully in the studio and on the gym floor. Aimed at individuals who want to focus on developing fundamental strength as well as those ready to work towards hypertrophy, or muscle growth, this 45-minute class uses a barbell and free weights combined with specific tempos and rep ranges to help achieve those goals.

707297.name: Family Fitness
707297.desc: A workout that the whole family can enjoy together! Get active and fit alongside your kids with a variety of functional and modifiable exercises to improve overall fitness.

903111.name: Christ-Centered Yoga
903111.desc: Christ centered yoga embraces the essential elements of yoga: breath work, physical postures and meditation; while putting Christ at the center. In this class, you are invited to connect with your physical breath as well as the Holy Spirit; deepen your connection with Jesus; and integrate your body and faith through moving meditation. Christ-centered yoga also includes scripture reading, prayer, and an embodied worship experience.

1141394.name: Cardio Blast
1141394.desc: Cardio Blast is a fun mix of at least two different cardio styles in every class! Workouts may include low-impact movement, higher-impact options, kickboxing, basic step, dance-inspired cardio and more. Each class offers plenty of variety to get your heart pumping, with low-impact options available.

1134992.name: Plank 360 ($)
1134992.desc: Push yourself to the next level! This cardio-infused, strength Pilates class keeps you moving from beginning to end. Mixing in cardio movements, traditional Pilates tower and mat exercises with a series of plank workouts, youʼll get a full-body, unique and form-focused higher-intensity session that will leave you energized and wanting more.

709306.name: ABC Program
709306.desc: In this 16-week program for breast cancer survivors, participants receive free, full access to the Y along with group personal training, nutrition counseling, Lymphedema education and small group support from Y staff, volunteers and other participants. This is a private, closed group. Please contact your local Y to learn how to join this program!

900236.name: Meditation
900236.desc: This class is designed for participants to relax, reset, and calm your mind and body. Together, the class will practice mindfulness or meditation, to help cultivate more gratitude, compassion, and peace in your life. No prior experience required.

707143.name: Teen Strength & Conditioning
707143.desc: Teen Strength & Conditioning provides education and utilization on the proper mechanics & technical aspects of exercise. This class will help aid in the daily progression & maintenance of overall health and wellness by utilizing barbells, free weights, functional equipment, and more.

1066453.name: Swim Team & Swim Lessons (1-2 lanes in use)

707271.name: Les Mills RPM
707271.desc: Control your own intensity in this group indoor cycling workout that's fun and low impact. With great music pumping and the group spinning as one, you'll go on a journey of hill climbs, sprints and flat riding to help you boost your cardio fitness.

1145727.name: Youth Pop-Up Class
1145727.desc: Try something new with our Youth Pop-Up Classes! These limited-time youth activity offerings appear periodically on the schedule and may feature new formats, instructors, or specialty classes designed just for kids ages 6-12. Contact the Welcome Center for details about the class being offered.

706802.name: Low Impact HIIT
706802.desc: Get out of your comfort zone and accelerate results with high-intensity interval training. Classes combine short bursts of intense exercise with short recovery periods, and utilize cardio and strength exercises. Formats include Tabata, AMRAP and more. Just like your regular HIIT class, but taught with primarily low impact options, meaning at least one of your feet will stay on the ground for most of the class. Ideal for those looking for less impact on their joints, for those coming back from injury, or those new to working out.

1106043.name: Pilates Tower Mat Fusion ($)
1106043.desc: A fun, full-body class that blends the core-strengthening principles of Mat Pilates with the versatility of Pilates props, the challenge of TRX suspension straps, and the graceful, muscle-toning movements of Barre. Each class is designed to improve strength, balance, flexibility, posture, and core stability while keeping every workout fresh and engaging. Whether you’re new to fitness or an experienced exerciser, modifications and progressions are provided so you can move at your own pace and feel successful every step of the way.

1000163.name: Les Mills Yoga Yin
1000163.desc: This class is a restorative practice with long-held poses that release tension, calm the nervous system, and gently reset the body and mind.

974030.name: Les Mills Breath
974030.desc: This class blends breathwork and movement set to uplifting music to help you clear your head, ground your body, and tune inward.

708129.name: Les Mills DANCE
708129.desc: LES MILLS DANCE is a 45-minute high-energy workout that will challenge and move you. It combines innovative dance movements with the latest music to drive energy and motivation in every move.​ With a focus on movement and technique, LES MILLS DANCE is simple to master and a great option for those who want to improve their dance skills while getting fit or for anyone who loves to dance.
